title: Huge Ulta Beauty Haul and Free Gift!
description: Check out what I got with my ulta beauty gift card :smiling face with smiling eyes: thanks for watching :red heart:

asr.full_text: Hello everyone and welcome back today i wanted to go over my ulta haul with you guys remember i said. I had a huge haul coming i did receive a gift card for my birthday i'm just trying to get in the frame. As always i do test before i come on but it seems to never go right when i um when i'm actually. Recording let me get my lighting okay um originally i purchased with my ulta gift card the ulta beauty. Basics seven piece favorite kit i hope you can see that i haven't opened anything or try anything. I wanted to go ahead and get the video done before i did any of the products because if in case you. Guys wanted to see a review on each individual thing or a full face or with the products or. Whatever um i wanted it to be the first time my very first review for you all so okay don't want. To make the video too long but anyway the seven piece beauty kit came with a full matte bronzer. And i'm sorry i'm getting my reflection and everything i have a mirror over here with a. Light so I can see it comes with a palette eyeshadow palette now I did read reviews on. This before I purchased it and no one really liked the palette they said it was no. Pigmentation with the colors so I'm not really an eyeshadow person as you can tell but. I figured for seven pieces I forgot how much it was I think twenty dollars. All right, other things that came with was a dewy matte finishing spray, makeup finishing spray, a full shiny sheer lip gloss. I love sheer lip gloss, especially for work, just to refresh my lip color. A high light brow pencil, which I didn't even know what that was for. I had to ask my niece how to use that. A full classic black felt tip eyeliner and brow shaping gel never really used brow shaping gel. Before but I figured I'd give everything a try just to try some new things okay so that was it. For my purchase now Ulta had a deal going on where you bought $20 or more at the Ulta beauty brand. You got a free gift so that's why I chose that for $20 now for my free gift. Check this out I got this Ulta Beauty collection meet our faves box okay it. Says it's a $48 value and it was $20 but I got it for free with my purchase and. It opens up like this is really cute and it comes with a detoxifying charcoal. Mask for your face a little lotion I figured I would throw that in my purse this is an illuminator. I had to ask my niece what that was for that is um I'm sure you all know it's like a powdered. Highlight I'm used to using like cheek sticks or dazzle drops for my highlight but that's like a. Powdered highlight another sheer shiny lip gloss a full mascara and this bath is that I will probably. Never use I'm going to give that to my niece and a eye single eye shadow it's like a shimmery color. Okay so that was all I had I wanted to share it with you all and I wanted to get your feedback. On anything that you would like to see if you wanted me to do a full face with everything. Today I'm coming from work I had the afternoon off so I have my everyday makeup on before I came. On camera however I did use my born to glow NYX highlight under my brows and on the tip of my nose. And on my cheekbones I don't know how much you can see with this lighting and I use my F cream. Contour palette to contour my nose and highlight it just a little bit so those are two other things. I've been playing around with as far as makeup all right guys thank you so much for watching. Thank you for your time. If there's anything else you would like to see, please feel free to let me know. Until next time, until we do some more head scratching, see you later. Bye-bye.
